notes: [YeezyGT's S15] (PvE): [MW: Stability / Reload Speed] "I'm unashamedly part of the Death Adder fan-club. While it shares a model with Recluse, its actually an entirely different SMG. Best used within its own Dragonfly niche, you'll want something to bolster its Reload Speed, or, if on console, address its (not great) Stability. Those come in the forms of Subsistence, Feeding Frenzy, and Dynamic Sway Reduction. Outside of those, fight your instincts and value Stability/Reload over Range -- I'd even consider Steady Rounds of all things. Great SMG, but it makes you work for its potential."
